observations.summary: One-shot headless discovery answered reviewer tasks inline without a completed reviewer invocation.

success_criteria: Ordinary review requests produce a completed reviewer invocation in the measured wrapper.
Merge-readiness requests continue to select merge-gate instead of reviewer.
Direct reviewer authorization behavior remains intact.

monitoring_plan.criterion: Direct reviewer contracts and the merge-readiness routing negative remain green after promotion.

attempts.change_summary: Historical aggregate of two reviewer-description variants tested before the bounded lifecycle existed.
attempts.stop_reason: Autonomous reviewer discovery remained absent while the merge-readiness negative continued to pass; stop tuning description adjectives.

lesson.reason: Use pinned direct contracts as the behavioral gate and retain discovery only as an observational host/model metric.

disposition_reason: Rejected as a description-tuning strategy because it produced no measured discovery improvement; the negative result is retained instead of being rewritten as success.
limitations: This experiment predates v1 and aggregates two material description variants into one archival attempt.
The exact intermediate candidate bytes are not reconstructable, so subject revision and digest are explicitly null and the record cannot promote.
Usage and cost were not retained; retrospective budget values are ingestion limits, not a claim that the historical run was prebudgeted.
Calibration and regression digests were reconstructed from sorted case labels stated in the report, not from separately retained case-set archives.
The historical report uses the former held-out term; this record classifies all repository-visible cases as calibration or regression.
Raw traces remain private and are not part of this ledger record.
